title: 7ecb(c): slot-claim lowest-IID tiebreak compares routable low-half vs SHA-512 IID
description: Cluster 3 of 7ecb. resources.rs:2111: our_iid = self.info.iid[8..16] (ROUTABLE low half) compared via slot::compare_iids against their_iid = claim.gateway_iid() (SHA-512 IID per verify_iid_binding trust.rs:505). Live production conflict-resolution divergence: two gateways resolve the tiebreak on different value sets, so both can win or both yield. FIX: derive our_iid as the SHA-512 IID of the local pubkey (same plane as the wire claim) for the tiebreak. Masked in tests by fabricated coordinator address (resources.rs:3224-3226). cargo test -p lichen-gateway green.
